# Visualforce pages must opt into the CSP header.
# The exclusion spans forward, so the clean page comes first.
# ok: csp-header-attribute
<apex:page cspHeader="true">
content
</apex:page>
# ruleid: csp-header-attribute
<apex:page>
content
</apex:page>
# ruleid: csp-header-attribute
<apex:page>
more content
</apex:page>
